records.jp: （見慣れた机と椅子だけど^00　外にあるのは不思議な感じ）
records.en_original: (A normal desk and chair.^00It's a bit strange seeing it outside.)
records.en: (It's the same familiar desk and chair,^00but seeing them outside feels strange.)

records.jp: （日向で勉強なんかしたら^00　すぐうとうとしちゃう）
records.en_original: (Nothing like studying outside.^00Just don't get distracted.)
records.en: (If I tried studying in the sun,^00I'd start nodding off in no time.)

records.jp: （外で勉強なんて発想、私じゃ絶対に出ないね）
records.en_original: (Studying outside... Not something I would've thought of.)
records.en: (Studying outside... Not something I would've thought of.)

records.jp: （こういうのに寝そべるの、憧れてたんだよね。^00今度サングラスとかも用意しよう）
records.en_original: Perfect for kicking back.^00Shades recommended.
records.en: (I've always wanted to lounge on one of these.^00I should get some sunglasses next time.)

records.jp: （バカンスといえば、やっぱりカラフルなジュース！^00……あり合わせで作ったやつだから、味はいまいち）
records.en_original: (Tropical vacay equals drink in a coconut!^00Too bad all we had was water...)
records.en: (A vacation calls for a colorful drink!^00...I made this with whatever we had, so it doesn't taste great.)

records.jp: （ここで本を読みながら^00　寝落ちしたら気持ちいいだろうなぁ）
records.en_original: (I'd love to lay here with a book and just drift off to sleep.)
records.en: (It'd feel so nice to lie here reading^00until I drifted off to sleep.)

records.jp: （神様にお祈りする時は^00　二礼二拍手一礼……だっけ？）
records.en_original: (How much am supposed to give again...?)
records.en: (When praying to the gods,^00it's two bows, two claps, one bow... right?)

records.jp: （５円玉、持ってたかな？）
records.en_original: (Got any cash on you?)
records.en: (Do I have a five-yen coin?)

records.jp: （ソースのいい匂い……^00　お腹が空いてきたかも）
records.en_original: (That takoyaki smells amazing...^00Now I'm hungry.)
records.en: (That sauce smells so good...^00I think I'm getting hungry.)

records.jp: （トッピングの種類^00　意外と豊富だ！）
records.en_original: (All the toppings you could imagine and more!)
records.en: (There are more toppings^00than I expected!)

records.jp: （今日はもう水あげたっけ？）
records.en_original: (Uh oh...^00Did I water these already?)
records.en: (Did I water these already today?)

records.jp: （アサガオを育てるのなんて、小学生のころ以来。^00　枯らさないように気を付けなくちゃ）
records.en_original: (Last time I grew flowers they all died...^00Eh, I'm sure it'll be fine.)
records.en: (I haven't grown morning glories since elementary school.^00I'd better make sure they don't wither.)

records.jp: （せっかくの機会だし、観察日記でも書こうかな）
records.en_original: (I should keep a log, just like in science class.)
records.en: (Maybe I should keep an observation journal while I have the chance.)

records.jp: （木登りに丁度よさそうな高さだね。^00　……服が汚れるから登らないけど）
records.en_original: (The perfect size for climbing.^00Not that I'd ever do something so unladylike.)
records.en: (It looks like the perfect height for climbing.^00...But I won't, since I'd get my clothes dirty.)

records.jp: （木陰で寝るの、気持ちよさそうだなぁ）
records.en_original: (Can't wait to nap in the shade.)
records.en: (It would feel so nice to nap in the shade.)

records.jp: （いつ見ても立派な木だなぁ。^00　なんだか神聖なもののような気がしてくるね）
records.en_original: (This tree is always so beautiful. It must be blessed by the gods.)
records.en: (It's such an impressive tree every time I see it.^00It almost feels sacred somehow.)

records.jp: （プールで遊んだあとは^00　忘れずここで体を流そう）
records.en_original: (Gotta shower after playing in the pool!)
records.en: (After playing in the pool,^00I need to remember to rinse off here.)

records.jp: （てっぺんのクジラがチャームポイントだね！）
records.en_original: (The whale at the top is too cute!)
records.en: (The whale on top is the cutest part!)

records.jp: （実はおそろいのマークのタオルも作ったんだ。^00　たまに教室で干してるんだよね）
records.en_original: (We made matching towels too. I'm sure they're around here somewhere...)
records.en: (We made towels with the same logo too.^00Sometimes we hang them up to dry in the classroom.)

records.jp: （見ると無性に靴を飛ばしたくなってくる。^00　今度最高記録に挑戦してみようかな？）
records.en_original: (Looking at this makes me want to jump on and swing as high as I can...)
records.en: (Seeing this makes me want to kick off my shoes.^00Maybe I'll try to set a new distance record next time.)

records.jp: （ブランコに座ってぼーっとしている時間が^00　実は結構好きなんだ）
records.en_original: (I really love sitting on a swing and just letting my mind wander.)
records.en: (I actually really like sitting on a swing^00and just letting my mind wander.)

records.jp: （こうして遊具を置いてみると^00　学校も公園に見えてしまう不思議）
records.en_original: (Just having these swings here really makes this place look like a playground.)
records.en: (It's funny how adding playground equipment^00makes the school look like a park.)

records.jp: （夏と言えばやっぱりかき氷！^00　色んなシロップがあって迷っちゃうなぁ）
records.en_original: (Nothing like shaved ice in the summer!^00I can never decide which flavor to get.)
records.en: (Nothing like shaved ice in the summer!^00I can never decide which flavor to get.)

records.jp: （のどが乾いたらここで休憩だね）
records.en_original: (I'm thirsty. Time to grab a drink.)
records.en: (When I get thirsty, this is the place to take a break.)

records.jp: （海の家で食べる焼きそばって^00　なんであんなにおいしいんだろう？）
records.en_original: (There's something about having yakisoba at the beach.)
records.en: (Why does yakisoba from a beach hut^00taste so good?)

records.jp: （短冊に書くお願い、なにがいいかな？^00　……やっぱ世界平和？）
records.en_original: (Hmm, what should I wish for? ...World peace?)
records.en: (What should I write on my tanzaku?^00...World peace, maybe?)

records.jp: （笹の葉擦れの音^00　涼し気な気分になれて好きなんだよね）
records.en_original: (I love the sound of bamboo rustling in the wind. It has a cooling effect, somehow.)
records.en: (I love the sound of bamboo leaves rustling.^00It somehow makes me feel cooler.)

records.jp: （そういえば、七夕はもう過ぎたんだっけ。^00　この世界の日付ってどうなっているんだろう……？）
records.en_original: (Wait, is Tanabata over already? How does time work here anyway...?)
records.en: (Come to think of it, has Tanabata already passed?^00How do dates even work in this world...?)

records.jp: （縁側に座ってかき氷を食べるのが^00　ここ最近のマイブーム）
records.en_original: (Recently I've been super into having shaved ice on the veranda here.)
records.en: (Lately, I've been really into sitting on the engawa^00and eating shaved ice.)

records.jp: （日照りがつらくなったら、ここに避難だね）
records.en_original: (This place has been a lifesaver on hot, sunny days.)
records.en: (This place has been a lifesaver on hot, sunny days.)

records.jp: （風鈴の音が涼し気でいい感じ）
records.en_original: (Wind chimes remind me of brisk summer nights.)
records.en: (The sound of wind chimes feels so cool and refreshing.)

records.jp: （これがいわゆる同人誌。^00　そういえば図書室でも何冊か見た気が……）
records.en_original: (Indie comics? I think I saw some in the library too...)
records.en: (So this is what they call doujinshi.^00Come to think of it, I think I saw a few in the library...)

records.jp: （この絵、伶那さんが書いたんだよね。^00　どのくらい練習したんだろう）
records.en_original: (Rena drew this one. I wonder how much she practices.)
records.en: (Rena-san drew this one.^00I wonder how much she practices.)

records.jp: （あ、足元の段ボールにもまだ在庫がある。^00　ずいぶんたくさん作ったなぁ）
records.en_original: (Wow, all these boxes are full of comics too. Rena sure made a lot of copies...)
records.en: (Oh, there are still copies in the boxes at my feet.^00We sure made a lot of these.)

records.jp: （こんな大きいものが空を飛ぶんだから^00　科学って不思議だ）
records.en_original: (I can't believe something so huge can actually fly. Science is crazy!)
records.en: (Something this huge can fly through the sky...^00Science is amazing.)

records.jp: （表面がひんやりしているから^00　地味に避暑スポットなんだよね）
records.en_original: (The surface is always cold, so it's a good place to come and cool down on a hot day.)
records.en: (The surface stays nice and cool,^00so it's a surprisingly good place to escape the heat.)

records.jp: （このレトロトイっぽい塗装がお気に入りなんだ）
records.en_original: (I like how it's painted like an old toy.)
records.en: (I like how it's painted like an old toy.)

records.jp: （火をともすタイプの街燈だ！^00　レトロなものって見てるとわくわくするよね）
records.en_original: (A lamp lit with a real flame! I love this kind of old-fashioned stuff.)
records.en: (A streetlamp lit by a real flame!^00Old-fashioned things like this are so exciting.)

records.jp: （こういう街燈が似合う街に住んでみたいなぁ）
records.en_original: (I'd love to live in a rustic town with streetlamps like this.)
records.en: (I'd love to live in a town where streetlamps like this fit right in.)

records.jp: （上の部分がシルクハットみたいだから^00　遠目で見るとのっぽな人に見えなくもない）
records.en_original: (It looks like it's wearing a top hat!)
records.en: (The top looks like a silk hat,^00so from a distance it almost looks like a tall person.)

records.jp: （商店街かぁ……^00　うちの周りにはあんまりなかったな）
records.en_original: (We didn't have any shopping streets near my house.)
records.en: (A shopping street, huh...^00There weren't many around where I lived.)

records.jp: （ノスタルジーを感じるデザインだよね）
records.en_original: (I like its charming, old-fashioned design.)
records.en: (I like its charming, old-fashioned design.)

records.jp: （ハート形の風船って……^00　ずいぶん浮かれた商店街だ）
records.en_original: (The heart-shaped balloons make it look like a lively place.)
records.en: (Heart-shaped balloons...^00This shopping street sure is festive.)

records.jp: （デパートの屋上遊園地によくあるやつ！^00　……まあアニメの中でしか見たことはないんだけど）
records.en_original: (Oh, I used to see these at amusement parks all the time! ...In anime, at least.)
records.en: (It's one of those rides you see at rooftop amusement parks!^00...Well, I've only ever seen them in anime.)

records.jp: （なんでクマなんだろう。^00　人が乗るなら馬とかじゃないのかな……？）
records.en_original: (Why is it a bear? Can you even ride a bear?)
records.en: (Why a bear?^00If people are going to ride it, wouldn't a horse make more sense...?)

records.jp: （実はミニチュアの置物も一緒に作ったんだよね。^00　教室の窓際に飾ってあるんだ）
records.en_original: (We made a bunch of miniature animals too. The classroom's decorated with them.)
records.en: (We actually made miniature ornaments too.^00They're displayed on the classroom windowsill.)

records.jp: （井戸での水汲みは大変だけど^00　水道よりも美味しい気がするんだよね）
records.en_original: (Well water tastes so good. It's totally worth all the pumping!)
records.en: (Drawing water from a well is hard work,^00but it somehow tastes better than tap water.)

records.jp: （底の方をじっと見ていると^00　なんだか吸い込まれそうだ……）
records.en_original: (Looking down into it makes me feel like I'll get sucked in...)
records.en: (If I stare down at the bottom,^00it feels like I might get pulled in...)

records.jp: （こういう古びた井戸が出てくる怪談^00　なんてタイトルだったっけ？）
records.en_original: (What was the name of that scary movie with the lady who came out of the well?)
records.en: (What was the title of that ghost story^00with an old well like this...?)

records.jp: （これさえあれば、停電のときでも安心！）
records.en_original: (Even if the power goes out, we'll be a-okay!)
records.en: (Even if the power goes out, we'll be a-okay!)

records.jp: （こういう大きな機械って^00　いつまでも眺めていられるよね）
records.en_original: (This machine is so huge... I could stare at it forever.)
records.en: (Huge machines like this are fascinating.^00I could stare at them forever.)

records.jp: （環境に優しいエコな発電機！^00　……この世界に環境問題とかあるのかな？）
records.en_original: (An eco-friendly way of generating power! ...Though I don't know if that's a concern in this world.)
records.en: (An eco-friendly power generator!^00...Does this world even have environmental problems?)

records.jp: （晴れた日はここでピクニックだ！）
records.en_original: (It would be fun to camp out here when the weather's nice!)
records.en: (On a sunny day, this would be the perfect place for a picnic!)

records.jp: （バーベキューセットも欲しくなってきちゃうな）
records.en_original: (Aw, now I want a barbecue set, too...)
records.en: (Aw, now I want a barbecue set, too...)

records.jp: （椅子に座ってうたた寝する時間が至福。^00　……レジャーシートでごろ寝も捨てがたい）
records.en_original: (Nothing better than a good nap in a comfy chair. ...Though sprawling out on a blanket comes close.)
records.en: (Napping in the chair is pure bliss.^00...Though lying on the picnic sheet is tempting too.)

records.jp: （ひまわりってなんでこんなに背が高いんだろう。^00　ずっと見上げたら首が痛くなりそうだ）
records.en_original: (I had no idea sunflowers could grow so tall.)
records.en: (Why do sunflowers grow so tall?^00My neck might start hurting if I keep looking up.)

records.jp: （これだけ大きいと、水をあげるのも一苦労だ）
records.en_original: (It's tough to water plants this big.)
records.en: (It's tough to water plants this big.)

records.jp: （形はまるで、太陽みたい。^00　辺りの雰囲気もなんだか明るく見える）
records.en_original: (They really brighten the place up, all round and yellow like the sun!)
records.en: (They're shaped just like the sun.^00They make the whole area feel brighter somehow.)

records.jp: （使い方が結構難しい……^00　図書室で説明書、探してみようかな）
records.en_original: (This thing's pretty tough to use...^00I wonder if the library has anything on it?)
records.en: (This thing's pretty tough to use...^00I wonder if the library has anything on it?)

records.jp: （星座とか全然詳しくなくても^00　見てると意外と楽しいんだよね）
records.en_original: (A lot of fun even if you don't know the names of all the constellations like SOME people.)
records.en: (Even if I don't know much about constellations,^00it's surprisingly fun to look through this.)

records.jp: （おっと危ない。^00　倒さないように注意して触らないと）
records.en_original: (I better be careful. Don't wanna knock this over...)
records.en: (Whoa, careful.^00I need to make sure I don't knock it over.)

records.jp: （プールにお湯を張ってお風呂にしちゃうなんて^00　普通の学校だったら絶対無理だよね）
records.en_original: (There's no way we'd be allowed to turn the pool into a bath at a regular school!)
records.en: (Turning the pool into a hot bath^00would never be allowed at a normal school.)

records.jp: （こんなにたくさんの風呂桶^00　一体どこにあったんだ……？）
records.en_original: (How did all these buckets get here?!)
records.en: (Where did all these bath pails^00even come from...?)

records.jp: （お風呂といえばアヒルのおもちゃ。^00　……どうしてアヒルなんだろう？）
records.en_original: (Who decided that rubber ducks should be the standard bathtime toy?)
records.en: (A bath means a rubber duck.^00...Why a duck, though?)

records.jp: 今は寝ている場合じゃない！
records.en_original: Now's not the time for a nap!
records.en: Now's not the time for a nap!

records.jp: （寝転がってジュースを飲めば^00　完璧にバカンス気分！）
records.en_original: (Lying back and drinking juice really puts me in the vacation mood!)
records.en: (Lying back with a drink^00really makes it feel like a vacation!)

records.jp: （緑とオレンジの優しい色合いが^00　気に入ってるんだよね）
records.en_original: (I really love these soft shades of green and orange.)
records.en: (I really like the soft shades^00of green and orange.)

records.jp: （パラソルだけだと心もとないから^00　寝転がるときは日焼け止めを忘れずにね）
records.en_original: (Just a parasol won't do, so I'd better remember to put on sunscreen before I lie down and sleep.)
records.en: (A parasol alone isn't enough,^00so I need sunscreen before lying down.)

records.jp: （このやる気のなさそうな尻尾が^00　かわいいよね）
records.en_original: (It's cute how its tale seems to reveal its lack of motivation.)
records.en: (That listless-looking tail^00is so cute.)

records.jp: （なぜどっちもトラ……？^00　まあ作ったのは私たちだけど）
records.en_original: (Why are they both tigers...? Although, it was me who made them.)
records.en: (Why are they both tigers...?^00Well, we're the ones who made them.)

records.jp: （ふかふかで気持ちいいけど^00　夏場にはちょっと暑いかな）
records.en_original: (It's certainly fluffy and comfy, but a little too hot for summer.)
records.en: (It's soft and comfortable,^00but it might be a little hot in summer.)
